key_implementation_notes: naming: IndexStageError + IndexStageCancelledError (avoid Python builtin IndexError name collision in stack traces)
_build_asr_provider() seam: Settings-driven LocalWhisperProvider construction; module-level so unit tests monkeypatch it instead of patching faster_whisper

_atomic_write_json(): tmp + flush + fsync + os.replace mirroring state.py _save_atomic per Round 3 BUG#8 — without fsync OS crash could install empty tmp

RUNNING transition ownership: handler does NOT call mark_stage(RUNNING) — runner._stage_entrypoint owns it (Round 4 BUG#10 reverted Round 3 BUG#7 wrong fix). LIM#8 records that runner.py Protocol docstring still says 'Handler must mark its own RUNNING' which is false — fix deferred to M2a kickoff

Empty ASR sentences is LEGAL (silent / music-only audio per integration test docstring) but emits WARNING with audio_path/provider/language/actionable hint per Round 6 fix — observability for M2a scripting downstream failures
K9 cleanup: Path.unlink(missing_ok=True) — idempotent; post-condition 'audio.wav does not exist' satisfied either way
PEP 563: handler signature test asserts annotation in (None, 'None') because from __future__ import annotations defers evaluation to strings
self_check_lessons_top3: called API ≠ knows contract: must read RUNTIME caller's implementation (not just module-under-test or unit tests which mock the runtime path away). Round 3→4 self-introduced regression proved this
test design must include reverse assertions ('handler must NOT do X') paired with positive ones — protects against condition-widening regressions; Round 4 + Round 6 both used this pattern

expanding scope to read DEPENDENCIES (Shot.__post_init__ / _postprocess_segments drop rules / ASRBase schema / integration test docstrings) is the goldmine of multi-round self-check after re-reading the same files yields diminishing returns; Round 6 found 2 should-fix this way after 5 rounds of zero new finds on index.py itself
